proposal.thesis: Airbnb reported Q2 2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30) revenue of $3.6B, +17% YoY, net income $816M, and adjusted EBITDA $1.3B / 35% margin, and it exceeded its own outlook on every key metric (8-K / shareholder letter filed 2026-08-06). That is the first EPS beat after three straight misses ($1.37 vs $1.25; news_and_catalysts). Management raised the bar: Q3 revenue $4.69-4.77B (15-17% YoY, vs street ~$4.61B) and full-year 2026 revenue growth to at least mid-teens from the prior low-to-mid-teens, with adjusted EBITDA margin at least 35.5% (Airbnb IR and CNBC, 2026-08-06). Do not use the digest's 58.8% YoY figure — that conflicts with the company's own 17% and with Q2 2025 revenue of $3.096B in sec_filings. The stock gapped from the mid-$150s to the $180s on the print and has spent six sessions digesting around $180-182 (last close $180.10 on 2026-08-12; today's options mark $181.35). Operating margin is expanding (TTM 22.86% vs 19.84% a year ago, quality_ratios, period ended 2026-06-30), the balance sheet is net cash of $4.35B, diluted shares are down 4.63% YoY, and TTM buybacks are $4.11B (3.8% yield). This is a consumer_platforms diversifier (corr_to_book 0.18, beta 0.88) against a book that is healthcare / energy / a single HPE server-capex probe. Options show a mild put lean (P/C vol 1.47, +4.9pp put skew, low confidence) so the stop sits under the post-gap hold, not inside the 3.81% ATR floor.
catalysts: Q2 2026 beat-and-raise reported 2026-08-06: revenue $3.6B (+17% YoY), first EPS beat after three misses, Q3 guide $4.69-4.77B, FY26 revenue growth raised to at least mid-teens and adj. EBITDA margin to at least 35.5% (8-K / Airbnb IR / CNBC)
Lagging 39-analyst mean target of $173.12 (bundle, -4.5% vs $180.10) still sits below the post-print tape; the swing is the remaining target catch-up into the $200 area
Nights and seats booked +10% YoY with acceleration in core US/France/UK/Australia markets (shareholder letter, 2026-08-06)

SPY is above its 200-DMA so the regime gate is open, and momentum_health is healthy (no unwind haircut). Universe participation is broad (75.8% above the 200-DMA, 57.5% beating SPY over 1m, A/D 1.51) and there are no active market_events flags. Ten-year yield at 4.70% (up from 4.46% three months ago) is the duration risk on a growth multiple; ABNB's net-cash, 35% FCF-margin print is the offset. This name is not an AI-stack add — consumer_platforms is a new demand_driver on a 67.8% cash book.
proposal.risk_map: This fails if (1) the 20% earnings gap is a one-day event and the stock fills back through the $168 hold — that is the structure kill, and today's mild options put lean (P/C 1.47) says some money is already hedging that path; (2) Q3 revenue prints below the $4.69B guide low or management walks the 'at least mid-teens' FY raise, which would confirm the 3-miss streak was the real run-rate; (3) SBC is 13.5% of quarterly revenue (quality_ratios, Q ended 2026-06-30) so GAAP earnings overstate cash earnings — a buyback pause or a take-rate cut to buy growth would hit the multiple; (4) a further backup in the 10-year from 4.70% compresses mid-teens-growth consumer multiples even if Airbnb executes. Early tell: a daily close back below $168 on rising volume, or a fresh estimate cut before the November print.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: 39 analysts rate ABNB a buy (mean 2.11) with a $173.12 mean target, 4.5% BELOW the $180.10 2026-08-12 close (news_and_catalysts / scan). Forward revenue growth in the bundle is 15.5% and the multiple is tagged fair (fwd P/E 35.4x, PEG 1.91). The market treated the August 6 gap as the whole re-rate. MY VIEW: the $173 mean is a lagging average of pre-print models. The company just raised FY26 revenue growth to at least mid-teens from low-to-mid-teens and guided Q3 to $4.69-4.77B against a ~$4.61B street number (Airbnb IR / CNBC, 2026-08-06), after the first beat in four quarters. MECHANISM: three straight misses anchored sell-side to a deceleration. Q2 nights/seats +10% with acceleration in the largest core markets, 35% adj. EBITDA, and $1.3B quarterly FCF (Q ended 2026-06-30) say the product/AI execution is converting, not leaking. Street's $173 average has not finished digesting that raise. RESOLUTION: sell-side targets moving through $190-200 over the next 2-3 weeks, and the Q3 print (~2026-11-05) against the $4.69-4.77B guide — I do not need to hold to November if the catch-up prints first.
